items.title: strands-decider
items.summary: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.
items.summary_cn: 一个小而快速的决策模型，或系统一个模型，用于代理工作流程。比LLM更快地在量表上选择选项或评分，并对每个决策都有校准的信心。
items.comment: 模型发布热闹非凡，能不能用、好不好用，用户说了算。

items.title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
items.title_cn: 为他们所有人制作动画的一个基础：实时头像的高斯混合形状蒸馏
items.summary: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshape...
items.summary_cn: 3D高斯化身支持快速渲染，然而，它们的实时动画往往受到昂贵的神经推断的挑战。我们解决了这一瓶颈，并表明预训练化身模型的动画可以通过身份独立混合形状的线性组合来近似...
items.comment: 商业模型再升级，功能看着牛，钱包要捂紧。

items.title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
items.title_cn: KaliBench ：在Kali Linux上使用网络安全工具的细粒度基准，具有无运行时可验证奖励
items.summary: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable comm...
items.summary_cn: LLM越来越多地应用于网络安全工作流程，他们有望将分析师的意图转化为工具调用。但是，现有的评估侧重于基于知识的评估或端到端的代理任务，并不能直接衡量LLM生成可执行通信的能力...
items.comment: 跑分赢了，实际用起来怎么样？用户体感比数字更重要。

items.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
items.title_cn: 重建、实践、实现：针对具体代理人的指导性自我提升
items.summary: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems withou...
items.summary_cn: 在各种任务中构建可靠的机器人能力需要大量的人力来开发和维护技能，设计奖励，并将感知与控制相结合。我们展示了Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real （ RPG ） ，这是一个用于自主改进机器人执行系统的框架...
items.comment: 政策收紧，大厂合规团队又要扩编了，创新空间还剩多少？
